extracted.intended_audience: general public; scientists and accessibility advocates interested in making scientific data accessible
extracted.subtask_description: A public TED Talk describing how a blind astronomer used sonification to continue research and advocating for a more inclusive scientific community. Useful for evaluating or producing talks or materials about accessibility, data sonification, and inclusive science communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility and inclusivity in science
rubrics_metrics.description: "Science is for everyone," she says. "It has to be available to everyone, because we are all natural explorers."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The talk frames a standard that scientific practice and its outputs should be made available to all people regardless of disability; advocacy for a 'more inclusive scientific community' is presented as an evaluative ideal for science institutions and communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of sonification to make visual data accessible
rubrics_metrics.description: "The light curves she could no longer see could be translated into sound."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sonification is presented as a concrete method for converting visual astronomical data (light curves) into audio so blind researchers can perceive and analyze the data. The page treats successful sonification as a practical criterion for restoring research capability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restoring researcher independence and mastery
rubrics_metrics.description: Through sonification, she regained mastery over her work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A measure of an accessibility solution's success is whether it enables the researcher to regain control and competence in performing their scientific tasks independently, not merely providing passive accommodation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal narrative as a vehicle for advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: When she lost her sight and was left without a way to do her science, she had a revelatory insight... and now she's advocating for a more inclusive scientific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The talk uses the speaker's lived experience to illustrate problems and motivate change; effective advocacy materials are expected to link personal experience to broader systemic recommendations.
